ModMetaData.description:
[h1] 超维科技人造人女仆 OuterrealmTech ArtificialMaid [/h1]
这是来自边缘世界所在宇宙维度外的超级国度的科技，超越了常规科技的极限。 集合了一系列超凡的、万能的、超出常人想象的、让人无法理解的、打破常规的东西。 它们将彻底改变殖民地建设和管理方式，让你体验到前所未有的便利和效率！
欢迎来到超维科技的世界！
这是一个物质和能量极度充裕且随心所欲获得的世界大同的理想世界，每个超维国度公民都有自己的人造人女仆。 人造人女仆贴身养育每个公民，每个女仆从小到大都陪伴和侍奉着同一个人。 人造人女仆同时是自己主人的母亲、青梅竹马、伴侣、朋友、兄弟、同桌、女友、妻子、心灵导师、x处理工具。
人造人女仆会自动修复自己，永远不会生病、受伤、死亡。即使在极端恶劣的环境下，人造人女仆也能保持最佳状态。
人造人女仆的所有技能都经过了极致的优化和强化，能够以超常的效率完成各种任务。无论是烹饪、清洁、医疗、还是战斗，人造人女仆都能胜任，并且表现出色。
失落、游荡、以及其他势力的人造人女仆会在见到玩家后会自动执行底层安全协议，执行全身修复并加入玩家的殖民地。
[hr][/hr]
Source Code : https://github.com/Lyoko-Jeremie/RimworldMods/tree/master/OuterrealmTechRobot

[h1] OuterrealmTech ArtificialMaid [/h1]
This is technology from a super-realm beyond the dimensional universe of the RimWorld, transcending the limits of conventional science. It features a collection of extraordinary, omnipotent, unimaginable, incomprehensible, and paradigm-breaking things. They will completely revolutionize the way your colony is built and managed, letting you experience unprecedented convenience and efficiency!
Welcome to the world of Outerrealm Tech!
This is an ideal world of great harmony where material and energy are extremely abundant and can be obtained at will. Every citizen of the Outerrealm has their own Artificial Maid. The Artificial Maid raises each citizen closely, accompanying and serving the same person from childhood to adulthood. The Artificial Maid is simultaneously her master's mother, childhood playmate, partner, friend, sibling, deskmate, girlfriend, wife, spiritual mentor, and X processing tool.
The Artificial Maid automatically repairs itself and will never get sick, injured, or die. Even in extreme and harsh environments, the Artificial Maid can maintain optimal condition.
All skills of the Artificial Maid are optimized and enhanced to the extreme, allowing it to perform various tasks with extraordinary efficiency. Whether it's cooking, cleaning, medical care, or combat, the Artificial Maid can handle it competently and perform excellently.
Lost, wandering, and other factions' Artificial Maids will automatically execute the underlying security protocol upon seeing the player, perform full-body repairs, and join the player's colony.
